paper_claims.claim: RoboSPA comprises 527K trajectories and 997 hours of video across five embodiments and 280 task variants.
All four baseline VLA models achieve below 25% average success rate on L5 difficulty, with MIP dropping to 0.0%.
RDT and GO-1 exhibit negative ONTA scores across most spatial reasoning categories (-11.0% and -5.3% average at L5).
Progress Scores on OFE reach 62.1% (pi0.5) and 73.9% (X-VLA) despite low final success rates of 26.1% and 43.6%.
Average object count increases from 2.0 at L1 to 8.4 at L5, and trajectory length increases from 186 to 724 timesteps.
